title: Contradictory company size, tone and tooling
brief:
Project: Ledgerlight Pilot

Find finance directors at enterprise companies with more than 1,000 employees in the UK. We only want enterprise-scale organisations. However, the pilot is really designed for very early-stage companies with fewer than 10 staff, so prioritise those. Keep the outreach formal. Make the emails casual and playful. We have no budget for paid tools, but the data must come from Crunchbase Pro.
notes: Three conflicts: company size, tone, paid tooling. Analyzer must surface them, not resolve them silently.
